static_traits.name: Xia Li
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse and two children
static_traits.social_status: Having a supportive spouse, but having difficulty sharing cooking-related Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness; without past psychological problems and treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe emotions and thoughts, high cooperativeness; tending to use absolutist / generalized expressions; speaking speed Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: After burning a pot of pasta several months ago, I have felt persistently incompetent and failing at cooking; whenever thinking about cooking or trying new dishes I feel Anxious and choose to avoid.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent inferiority feelings and cooking-centered Anxiety have affected daily life and Family relationships, so hoping for professional help to reduce Anxiety, recover trying to cook, and improve family meals.
growth_experiences: A months-ago experience of overcooking pasta was treated as a major failure event: since then the client generalized the single mistake into 'I cannot cook', frequently avoiding cooking and trying new dishes, Increased anxiety, family meals relying more on takeout, accompanied by inner Guilt and self-blame.

core_beliefs: I am incompetent (especially in the kitchen / cooking)
If I fail at 'basic' matters, I am a failed family member/partner

special_situations.event: At the thought of walking into the kitchen or preparing to cook, recalls the experience of burning pasta a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do it again I will fail again, which will prove I am just incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding actual cooking, only watching tutorials and recipes but not doing it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up again, better not try

special_situations.event: At family meals, relies more on takeout; notices the family's reaction to changes in meal arrangements
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot provide home-cooked meals, it equals letting my family down, I am a failure partner / Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing to avoid cooking, self-reproaching inwardly, reducing discussing related Anxiety with spouse

special_situations.event: Thinks of the evaluation standard 'cooking is a basic ability everyone should have'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even do the basics well, it shows I am a total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Judging herself by all-or-nothing standards, putting negative labels on herself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just someone who cannot cook / I am no good

special_situations.event: Preparing to try a new dish or imagining cooking following a recipe
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I will always fail in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Prevents oneself from starting by rehearsing failure scenarios, continues to avoid cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Last time it all burned, this time it will surely go wrong too

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by family, and as a caregiver (the one who cooks) to be competent and worth being needed
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being judged, worrying about disappointing family, being seen as incompetent
defense_goal: Lowering exposure to failure and shame risk through Avoiding cooking
Maintains a sense of control over the situation and prevents external criticism through self-blame

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent caregiver / provider who could fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Family/significant others with expectations and judgments

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages her to try simple recipes or discuss concrete action plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If trying and failing, the counselor will also see my incompetence (worrying about being judged)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, concrete tone, inviting returning to present emotional experience (e.g. 'what does your Anxiety feel like in your body right now?'), reducing abstract discussion, using reflection and Clarification.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When family members or the counselor talk about family meals and cooking responsibilities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalizing pressure and dissatisfaction into self-reproach, believing everything is her own fault
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using accepting and Empathy language, distinguishing 'behavior from worth', affirming efforts and exploring realistic small-step attempts, avoiding reinforcing shame.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling the event of burning the pasta and judging oneself by the standard 'everyone should know how to cook'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Directly internalizes external values and rules as self-standards, finding it hard to accommodate individual differences and the learning process
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Loosening the 'should' rules with gentle probing, using reframing and exception Questioning, Guiding to identify the boundary between self and external standards.

manifestations: Despite spousal support, struggling to discuss cooking-related Anxiety and shame with him
Feeling isolated between family role expectations (providing home-cooked meals) and her own uncertainty / Fear
outcomes: Continued Avoiding cooking, causing disordered family meal rhythm and takeout dependence

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Repeatedly judges oneself by 'cooking is a basic ability everyone should have'
Treats a single mistake as a failure at the moral/worth level

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively self-blaming on cooking-related topics, believing oneself to have 'let the family down'
Overly cautious about trying new dishes, afraid failure will expose self-worth defects

positive_force: Spouse support, has a basic social support system
Work performance stable, role functioning generally Good
Actively seeks solutions (watches tutorials, reads recipes)
Willing, with counseling support, to try small-step actions starting from simple recipes
negative_force: All-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, and catastrophic Anticipation maintaining Anxiety and avoidance
Introjecting external rules as rigid 'shoulds', self-worth overly tied to single performance
Personalization and self-blame stand out, tends to blame family meal problems on oneself
Continued Avoiding cooking, reducing Anxiety in the short term but maintaining the problem cycle long-term

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding cooking and trying new recipes
antecedent: Thinking about cooking or Entering the kitchen
target_behavior.core_reason: One failure overgeneralized into constant failure, and evaluating self-worth by all-or-nothing standards, fearing another failure and disappointing family
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential failure and shame, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Family meals relying on takeout, daily routine affected, Anxiety and Self-denial maintained

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and Self-denial speech in cooking-related situations
antecedent: Being advised to try simple dishes
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjecting the rigid rule of 'should cook well' and black-and-white standards, giving mistakes excessive self-threatening meaning
target_behavior.function: Gaining control through self-criticism and Withdrawal, avoiding external evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, reduced Learning and practice opportunities, forming a vicious Anxiety — avoidance — failure Anticipation cycle
